reply: Thank you for explaining that insurance claim checks for your home repairs have not been released, even though you have sent the contractors' documents many times. We understand the pressure from your insurer and contractors. Your complaint has been logged for review by the loss draft team. Please send a written request for a complete list of what is still needed to release the funds, and keep proof of everything you send. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you wired your mortgage payoff using the instructions in the payoff letter, and that the servicer now says it has no record of the wire. We understand how worrying this is. Your complaint has been logged for urgent review by the payments team. Please keep your bank's wire confirmation and the payoff letter, and ask your bank to trace the wire as well. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a remediation check related to your past loan modification has not been issued in your name alone, despite the court order removing your former spouse from the loan. We understand your frustration after so many years. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage servicing team. Please send a copy of the court order with your request in writing, and keep copies of all correspondence. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that, after your divorce, your request to assume the mortgage was declined for reasons that changed over time, including residency and income. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the mortgage team. Please ask in writing for the specific reasons for the decision and a list of documents that would address them, and keep copies of the W-2s and 1099s you sent. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your escrow account shows a property tax payment you had already paid yourself, creating a shortage and a higher monthly payment. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send a written notice of error with your tax receipts and the county's records, and ask for a corrected escrow analysis. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have been trying for months to receive a $1,100.00 property tax refund after your servicer overpaid your taxes. We understand the hardship this delay is causing. Your complaint has been logged for review by the escrow team. Please send a written request for the status of the refund to the servicer's designated address, and keep proof of delivery and your previous contacts. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your vehicle was repossessed shortly after you told the lender about your pending bankruptcy filing, and that you are being asked to pay far more than you believe is owed. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please ask in writing for an itemized statement of the amount demanded and any notices sent about the sale. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a technical error kept you from accepting your updated personal loan offer, and that the offer later expired even though you were told it would be extended. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please keep the error screenshots and notes of each call, and ask in writing whether the offer can be reconsidered. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your $890.00 line of credit was placed in a reserved account you could not use, while you were charged $230.00 in fees. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for the account terms and a full breakdown of the charges and the refund you received, and keep copies of your statements. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a closed account with no balance, reported as paid as agreed, still appears on your credit report and that you would like it removed. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Accurate positive information may remain on a credit report for some time, but if any detail is wrong, please dispute that item with supporting records. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that, after you set up a confirmed payment arrangement, the lender contacted your employer about wage garnishment. We understand how upsetting this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Most creditors can only garnish wages after a court judgment, so please keep the confirmation of your arrangement and ask in writing what was said to your employer. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your scheduled payment was returned for insufficient funds even though your bank statement shows the money was there, leading to $150.00 in fees. We understand the problems this caused with your landlord. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please send your bank statement with a written request for a review of the fees and a written explanation of the returned payment. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you completed your settlement with two payments totaling the agreed amount, but the account still shows late charges and is reported as charged off rather than settled. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please keep the settlement agreement and payment confirmations, and dispute the reporting with the credit reporting companies as well. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have repaid the $2,000.00 principal but still face about $4,600.00 in finance charges at a very high interest rate. We understand how difficult this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for your payment history and the loan terms, and ask what hardship or payoff options are available. A nonprofit credit counselor may also help. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you have been unable to log in to see your loan terms or pay the loan off early, and that the interest rate was not made clear before your payment. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for a copy of your loan agreement and a payoff quote, and keep the access error messages. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were told to change banks and reapply for a refinance, and then found you were no longer eligible. We understand your frustration and your concern about how little of each payment goes to principal. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please ask in writing for the eligibility requirements and a payment history showing how payments were applied. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your personal loan includes an origination fee even though you understood no such fee was charged, and that you received conflicting explanations. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please keep a copy of your loan agreement and the advertising you relied on, and ask in writing for an explanation of the fee. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you revoked the payment authorization for your cash advance, but the account was still debited under a different name. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please keep a copy of your revocation notice and its acknowledgment, and tell your bank in writing that the authorization was revoked so it can review the debits. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you are being held responsible for a $240.00 loan for a purchase you did not make, and that your calls have not resolved it. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please send a written dispute stating the purchase was not yours, with the loan details, and check your credit report for any accounts you do not recognize. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after your loan was credited as paid in full, an additional payment was also withdrawn, and that you have not been able to get it returned. We understand your frustration. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please send your bank statement showing the withdrawal with a written request for your account history, and report the debit to your bank as well. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you disagree with the earlier response about the interest rate on your loan, and that you are asking for a refund of interest you believe was excessive. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team, including the points in your follow-up. Please keep your loan agreement, payment records and the earlier response. Your state's financial regulator can also explain the rules that apply. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that weekly withdrawals of $33.00 were taken from your checking account even though your agreement called for a different payment, causing several $29.00 overdraft fees. We understand the hardship this has created. Your complaint has been logged for review by the payments team. Please send a written request for your payment schedule and history, and contact your bank about the overdraft fees. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that a loan was opened in your name without your knowledge, likely after a data breach, and that you first learned of it from a collection letter. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team. Please report the identity theft, keep the collection letter and your email, and check your credit reports for other accounts you do not recognize. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that an account was opened in your name without your authorization and that you have sent your Identity Theft Report. We are sorry this happened. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team, including your request to close the account and correct your credit files. Please keep copies of everything you sent, and contact the fraud departments of any other affected accounts. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that after years of payments on your $2,000.00 line of credit, most of what you paid went to billing cycle charges and the balance has grown. We understand how discouraging this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team, including your account closure request. Please ask in writing for your full fee and payment history. A nonprofit credit counselor may also help you review your options. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you receive several calls a day about a loan offer you never applied for, from changing numbers, even after opting out. We understand how disruptive this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the lending team. Please keep a log of the calls, including dates and numbers, and ask in writing that your information be removed from their call lists. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you did not make the purchases on your account and did not receive any goods or services. We understand your concern. Your complaint has been logged for review by the fraud team, including your request for an investigation of each transaction. Please send a written dispute listing the transactions, keep your card dispute records, and check your accounts for other activity you do not recognize. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you receive several calls a day about your loan even though you are not 30 days late, and that one agent was hostile. We understand your frustration and appreciate your feedback about the branch manager. Your complaint has been logged for review by the collections team. Please send a written request asking to be contacted by email, and keep a log of the calls. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that your loan, paid in full last year, still shows a $3,100.00 balance on your credit report even after the delinquency was corrected. We understand your concern about the effect on your credit. Your complaint has been logged for review by the credit reporting team. Please keep your payoff confirmation, and dispute the balance with the credit reporting companies, including a copy of that proof. You will receive an update once the review is complete.

Thank you for explaining that you were pressured into a paid mentorship during a sales call, that the loan was set up with income figures that were not yours, and that you could not cancel. We understand how stressful this is. Your complaint has been logged for review by the disputes team. Please keep the contract, any recordings or messages, and your dispute records, and ask in writing for the status of your dispute. You will receive an update once the review is complete.
